s1.p: Choose where you train and the plan that fits you.

s2.p: Sign up in 30 seconds. Your program is waiting in your profile.

s3.p: Video for every exercise, sets, reps and weights — on your phone.

s4.p: Charts, records and weekly check-ins. Every rep counts.

progress.title: TRACK EVERY REP.
progress.sub: The members area — your progress on one screen.
progress.p: Everyone who buys a program gets a personal account. Log every workout and see how you evolve — no paper, no spreadsheets.

adapted.title: ADAPTED TRAINING
adapted.big2: We get to know you first.
adapted.p: Every Adapted Training member starts with an online assessment. We meet, discuss your needs and goals, and make sure your program is properly adapted to you.

s2.p: A first call to get to know each other and set goals.

s3.p: Program, coaching and nutrition depending on your plan.

q1.q: Do I need experience to start?
q1.a: No. Every program is built for your level and evolves with you, week after week.

q2.q: How do I track my progress?
q2.a: With your account you log sets, reps and weights, and see charts, records and your streak.

q3.a: Yes, you can upgrade or switch plans anytime from your profile.

q4.a: It always starts with an online assessment. Then you get a program adapted to your movement needs, with coaching depending on your plan.

cta.p: The first rep is the hardest. The rest is just progress.
